source.label: FY2026 Form 10-K, Note 9 Income Taxes, income taxes paid (in millions)
source.quote: Income Taxes Paid Cash paid for income taxes, net of refunds received, by jurisdiction is as follows: 2026 U.S. federal $ 2,262 ... Cash paid for income taxes, net of refunds received $ 3,916 [USD millions, fiscal 2026]

notes: Taxes: cash paid for income taxes, net of refunds, from the FY2026 10-K income-tax note by jurisdiction (U.S. federal 2,262, California 207, other state 315, United Kingdom 315, other foreign 817; total 3,916 million). It includes a $1.8 billion payment of fiscal 2025 and part of fiscal 2024 U.S. federal and California taxes deferred under 2025 California wildfire relief, so fiscal 2026 is unusually high. R&D is not reported as a separate line in the FY2026 10-K.
